entities.name: A2RM05 QueT
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Lactococcus lactis subsp. cremoris MG1363; the query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match.
Length 169 aa; calculated molecular mass 19.07 kDa; theoretical pI 9.04; GRAVY 0.856, consistent with a strongly hydrophobic membrane protein.
Annotated as a multi-pass cell-membrane protein and queuosine precursor-binding S component of an energy-coupling factor transporter.
Pfam QueT domain PF06177.17 spans residues 9–162.
Curated annotation describes interaction with the ECF ABC-transporter complex; substrate binding is performed by transmembrane S components rather than soluble extracytoplasmic proteins.

entities.name: ECF transporter complex
observations: ECF transporter architecture includes membrane-embedded substrate-specific S components together with ATP-binding A components and transmembrane T components.
The reviewed QueT annotation states that the protein interacts with this energy-coupling factor ABC-transporter complex.

entities.name: Queuosine precursor transport
observations: QueT is annotated as a queuosine precursor-binding membrane component, suggesting a role in uptake of a queuosine biosynthesis precursor through an ECF transporter.
